items.title: Ellis Marsalis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 7, 2020
items.q: Harold Batiste was a mentor for me. He was about three years older than me. ... And he was a mentor for me in terms of saying this is chord changes, you know, this is like C7, this is how you voice that.

ctx.x: Okay. So at that time if you wondered what is a B flat 13 chord, where did you go to find that information?
